title: SMC (k) and Individual Unemployability Amounts — Disability Compensation
content:
**Special monthly compensation (k).** Each SMC (k) award on a Disability Compensation award adds 139.87 a month. No more than 3 SMC (k) awards are payable together with a schedular rate below the statutory ceiling. Both figures are the same at every tier, from Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) through Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating).

**Individual unemployability.** When individual unemployability is granted, the award is paid 3938.58 a month, which equals the veteran-alone rate at Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating). Employment with annual earned income at or below 15650.00 (the federal poverty guideline for one person) is treated as marginal. Whether a veteran at a given tier can meet the schedular thresholds for individual unemployability depends on the tier:

| Tier | Can meet the schedular thresholds | Individual unemployability monthly rate (USD) | Marginal-income threshold (USD a year) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) | No | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |
| Disability Compensation (20% Combined Rating) | No | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |
| Disability Compensation (30% Combined Rating) | No | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |
| Disability Compensation (40% Combined Rating) | No | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |
| Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating) | No | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |
| Disability Compensation (60% Combined Rating) | Yes | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |
| Disability Compensation (70% Combined Rating) | Yes | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |
| Disability Compensation (80% Combined Rating) | Yes | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |
| Disability Compensation (90% Combined Rating) | Yes | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |
| Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating) | No | 3938.58 | 15650.00 |

**Reading notes**

- The SMC (k) count is capped: an award showing 4 SMC (k) awards is paid for 3 of them, 419.61 a month (139.87 times 3); an award showing 2 is paid 279.74.
- Hypothetical illustration of the income threshold: annual earned income of exactly 15650.00 is marginal; 15650.01 is above the threshold.
